title: Weekly Regulation Monitoring Report
executive_summary: Report period 2026-07-09 to 2026-07-16: 2 EU policy items identified. No HIGH or MEDIUM risk changes. One LOW-risk item related to child online safety with potential impact on Smart TV modules (Browser/HbbTV, Voice assistant, AI features, Network services, Cybersecurity controls, OTA update, Remote control/voice input). One informational item with no immediate compliance changes.

key_changes.title: European Commission
key_changes.summary: EC special panel report and recommendations on child safety online. Low-risk but requires review of Smart TV child-safety features and data practices and preparation for possible follow-up actions.
recommended_actions: Obtain and review the EC special panel report and recommendations on child safety online
Gap-assess parental controls, content filtering, safe search, and age-gating in Browser/HbbTV apps
Review data collection, profiling, and advertising practices for minors; disable by default where applicable
Conduct/refresh a child-focused DPIA for voice assistant, AI features, and network services
Harden default privacy and safety settings for child profiles and guest modes
Prepare an OTA plan to deploy child-safety improvements and updated consent flows
Set up monitoring for any EC follow-up or legislative proposals stemming from the report

recommended_actions: Monitor EU policy updates on children’s online safety for any forthcoming rules impacting connected devices
